question: In August 2023, Neeraj Chopra made history by winning the ______ medal/s in the men's javelin throw event at the World Athletics Championships held in Budapest, Hungary.
solution:
The correct answer is __**gold**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neeraj Chopra** made history by winning the **gold medal** in the men's javelin throw event at the World Athletics Championships held in Budapest, Hungary, in August 2023.
 
• This victory marks a significant achievement for India in the field
